GBIF Sweden Biodiversity Data Gaps

Integrated Assessment: Spatial, Temporal, and Taxonomic Dimensions

GBIF Sweden

February 09, 2026

Executive Summary

This report presents a comprehensive assessment of biodiversity data gaps in GBIF Sweden’s occurrence database, integrating spatial, temporal, and taxonomic dimensions to inform strategic priorities for data collection and mobilization.

4.1 Key Findings

Summary of Data Gaps

Spatial Coverage: 89.9% of Sweden’s 10km grid cells have occurrence data.

Data Recency: 23.6% of cells have not been surveyed in over 5 years.

Taxonomic Coverage: 30.7% of Dyntaxa species have GBIF records.

Missing Threatened Species: 147 Critically Endangered and Endangered species lack GBIF records.

4.2 Priority Actions

Recommended Priority Actions
Priority Category Action Target
🔴 High Spatial Survey zero-coverage grid cells 0 cells
🔴 High Taxonomic Monitor CR and EN species lacking GBIF records 147 species
🟠 Medium Temporal Re-survey cells with >5 years since last observation 1,805 cells
🟠 Medium Taxonomic Digitize museum specimens for underrepresented orders Focus on low-coverage taxonomic groups
🟢 Low Spatial Expand citizen science programs to low-coverage regions Northern Sweden, mountainous regions
